fc2ab8c2e93dbe3aff5099f9d343fbf10d4a9556.sub_question_text: What check shows that the formal statement matches the theorem as mathematicians state it?

lines.black: Unchecked statement fidelity kills acceptance: the kernel certifies proof of the written statement, not that it is the real theorem. Only outside review closes this.

8b7a3aea69f18e72ba4e0ac0e2f47cf44f7762c7.sub_question_text: Must people be able to read and understand the proof, or is a machine check enough?

lines.black: A bare machine check is not enough: with 40,000 unreviewed lines, nobody can inspect definitions for a misstated claim, so readable key definitions are needed.
lines.green: Hypothesis: a short human-readable layer (statement plus key lemmas) may give understanding without reading all 40,000 lines; test whether referees can follow it.
